## Posterior error probability median and CrI
```{r, echo = FALSE}
i <- pars_summary$par == "probability of error"
sprintf("%.4f (%.4f-%.4f)", pars_summary$median[i], pars_summary$q2.5[i], 
        pars_summary$q97.5[i])
```

## Number of individuals
```{r, echo = FALSE}
nrow(samples$data)
```

## Number of individuals with at least one erroneous date in at least 50% of samples
```{r, echo = FALSE}
error_indicators <- samples$augmented_data$error_indicators
n_samples <- dim(error_indicators)[3]
n_individuals <- dim(error_indicators)[1]
  
## n_individuals by n_dates array of proportion of samples where the date is
## an error 
individual_has_errors <- 
  apply(error_indicators, c(1, 3), function(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)) > 0
## n_individuals vector of proportion of samples where the individual has
## as least one error
prop_individual_has_errors <- 
  apply(individual_has_errors, 1, sum) / n_samples
sum(prop_individual_has_errors >= 0.5)
```

### As a percentage
```{r, echo = FALSE}
round(sum(prop_individual_has_errors >= 0.5) / n_individuals * 100, 2)
```

## Number of individuals with at least one erroneous date in at least 95% of samples
```{r, echo = FALSE}
sum(prop_individual_has_errors >= 0.95)
```

### As a percentage
```{r, echo = FALSE}
round(sum(prop_individual_has_errors >= 0.95) / n_individuals * 100, 2)
```

## Delay estimates comparison with observed
```{r, echo = FALSE}
options(width = 100)
comparison_table <- pars_summary %>%
    filter(par %in% c("mean", "median", "cv")) %>%
    mutate(delay = paste0(gsub("_", " ", delay), " (", group, ")")) %>%
    mutate(value = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", median, q2.5, q97.5)) %>%
    select(par, delay, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = par, values_from = value) %>%
    rename(Delay = delay, "Estimated Mean" = mean, "Estimated Median" = median,
           "Estimated CV" = cv) %>%
    select(Delay, Mean, Median, CV) %>%
    right_join(summarise_observed(samples))
comparison_table
```

### LaTeX version
```{r, echo = FALSE}

latex_table <- knitr::kable(comparison_table, format = "latex", 
                            booktabs = TRUE, align = "lcccccc",
                            col.names = gsub("_", " ", names(comparison_table)),
                            linesep = "", digits = 2,
                            format.args = list(nsmall = 2)) %>%
               row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
print(latex_table)
```

## Delay parameter estimates (for supplement)
```{r, echo = FALSE}
options(width = 100)
delay_table <- pars_summary %>%
    filter(par %in% c("mean", "cv", "shape", "rate")) %>%
    mutate(delay = paste0(gsub("_", " ", delay), " (", group, ")")) %>%
    mutate(value = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", median, q2.5, q97.5)) %>%
    select(par, delay, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = par, values_from = value) %>%
    rename(Delay = delay, Mean = mean, CV = cv, Shape = shape, Rate = rate) %>%
    select(Delay, Mean, CV, Shape, Rate)
delay_table
```

### LaTeX version
```{r, echo = FALSE}

latex_table <- knitr::kable(delay_table, format = "latex", 
                            booktabs = TRUE, align = "lcccc",
                            linesep = "") %>%
               row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
print(latex_table)
```


## Number of missing onset dates

```{r, echo = FALSE}
onset_missing <- which(is.na(samples$data$onset))
n_onset_missing_by_group <- table(samples$data$group[onset_missing])
sum(n_onset_missing_by_group)
```

## Number of missing onset dates where date inferred by Garske et al are in 95% Credible Sets
```{r, echo = FALSE}
is_in_credible_set <- 
  unlist(lapply(onset_missing, 
                function(i) data_with_onset_inferred$onset_inferred[i] %in%
                  calc_credible_set(samples, i, 1, 0.95)))
n_in_credible_set_by_group <- 
  table(samples$data$group[onset_missing[is_in_credible_set]])
sum(n_in_credible_set_by_group)
```

### As a percentage of missing onset dates
```{r, echo = FALSE}
sum(n_in_credible_set_by_group) / sum(n_onset_missing_by_group) * 100
```
